title: Grays' moon base

tellings.quote: The grays who have a base on the moon come and go at any time they want.

plain: The grays, the small grey-skinned beings of UFO lore, have a base on the Moon and "come and go at any time they want." That is the claim of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years in the 1960s living alongside tall white aliens at a Nevada air base, and he says it to Michels as something he knows first-hand. If true, there would be a standing alien outpost right next door to Earth.
